decision.reasoning_trace: I started by filtering out items that were not actual Bluetooth speakers, such as battery replacements, carrying cases, and strap accessories. Within the speaker options, I narrowed my search to products with high ratings and significant review counts. The Sonos set was disqualified for being primarily Wi-Fi based. The consideration set includes a mix of powerful home units (Tenmiya, Sylvania) and highly-rated portables (JBL, Xeneo, Comiso). I ultimately selected the JBL Charge 4 (Renewed) because of the brand's reputation for sound quality and durability, offering the best performance-to-price ratio in the set despite being a refurbished unit.
